title: Adversarial review's headline 'FIX doctrine violated' finding is refuted by the shipped code
evidence: Review asserts: `street.gd:702` still gates the card's FIX button with `fix.disabled = _state["balance"] < fix_cost`. The diff replaces that line: removed `fix.disabled = _state["balance"] < fix_cost`, added `fix.disabled = fix_cost > 0 and _state["balance"] < fix_cost`.
detail: The review's prominent finding cites a line the diff explicitly replaces with a free-repair-aware guard (fix_cost > 0). The violation it describes does not exist in the shipped code.
recommended_fix: Re-baseline the adversarial review against the shipped commit so its findings match the actual code; drop this resolved FIX-doctrine item.

title: Story Task 3.3 and reviews cite `await reset.resized`; shipped code uses a bounded frame loop instead
evidence: Story Task 3.3: `_show_leaderboard()` wraps the fresh reset button after `await reset.resized`. Review: `await reset.resized` (street.gd:758) can suspend a coroutine forever. Code: `for _i in range(300):` / `await get_tree().process_frame`.
detail: Neither the story nor the reviews match the implementation: the code never awaits reset.resized; it polls get_global_rect() in a bounded 300-frame loop. The 'unbounded coroutine hang' hazard they describe is absent.
recommended_fix: Update story Task 3.3 and the reviews to describe the actual bounded-frame polling loop; drop the stale await reset.resized hang claim.

title: first_upgradeable lacks the missing-id guard that oldest_damaged_repairable has
evidence: oldest_damaged_repairable guards `var asset_id := int(asset.get("id", -1))` then `if asset_id < 0:` / `continue`. first_upgradeable instead does `return int(asset.get("id", -1))` with no guard.
detail: The two peers handle a missing id asymmetrically: one skips and keeps scanning, the other returns -1 and stops, silently suppressing a later valid upgrade. Latent (ids normally always present).
recommended_fix: Add the same `if id < 0: continue` guard to first_upgradeable before its return, mirroring oldest_damaged_repairable.
